thread:
jordan: Quick follow-up from the outage earlier—need concrete owners and timelines for the next steps we agreed in the retro. I’ll keep the action tracker updated.

maya: I can take the region-fallback playbook updates. Noted gaps: healthcheck thresholds and the model-registry fallback mapping. Plan: update runbook + run a tabletop drill. ETA: Thu 2026-04-08. :white_check_mark:

liam: I’ll own the model-registry token expiry hardening (rotate TTLs + add refresh metrics). Doing a patch next week, then a canary. ETA: 2026-04-05 for rollout to staging.

ana: @liam small ask—can you also add an alert on repeated 401s from the registry? We missed the pattern because rate of 401s was under noise.

liam: good call, adding an amplitude-based alert and a dedicated 401 monitor. Will link pager rule here after I create it.

ana: (typo, meant @ana)

ana: I’ll take auth-provider fallback verification. Today tokens expired earlier than the provider SLA window — need to validate our refresh logic and fallback tokens. ETA: 2026-04-06.

sam: From infra side: cloud provider network flap exposed a single-region dependency. I’ll own the multi-region failover for the control plane and the terraform changes to autoscale groups. ETA: 2026-04-12 for infra PRs, 2026-04-19 for a dry-run.

jordan: Solid. Can everyone add a short entry to the shared action tracker with: owner, artifact (runbook / terraform / alert), acceptance criteria, and ETA? I’ll chase any missing owners by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: New action created: "orchid-incident-2026-03-xx: region-fallback playbook update" assigned to maya, due 2026-04-08.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly incident drills scheduled Fri 2026-04-09. Sign up here: https://calendar.company/internal/drills

maya: Putting entries now: 
- owner: maya
- artifact: runbook "region-fallback"
- acceptance: automated dry-run with simulated provider outage, runbook verified within 5m
- ETA: 2026-04-08

liam: Tracker entry: 
- owner: liam
- artifact: model-registry token refresh + alerting
- acceptance: no unrefreshed tokens in a 24h synthetic test, alerts firing on >10 401s/min
- ETA: 2026-04-05

ana: Tracker entry (me): 
- owner: ana
- artifact: auth-provider fallback verification
- acceptance: regen-flow validated, fallback token path exercised, post-checks in place
- ETA: 2026-04-06

sam: Tracker entry: 
- owner: sam
- artifact: terraform for control-plane ASG + failover playbook
- acceptance: controlled dry-run with traffic shift, <2% error increase on client tests
- ETA: PR 2026-04-12; dry-run 2026-04-19

jordan: Perfect. A couple of cross-owners: liam + maya should sync on model-registry fallback mapping (which model variants to serve when registry is read-only). Can you coordinate?

liam: Yep, pinging maya. Suggest we add a simple priority map file stored with the registry config. Example: 
```
# priority_map.yaml
primary: redwood-model-v2
fallbacks:
  - redwood-model-v1-quant
  - llama-lite
```
Will make a PR and a test harness for read-only registry behavior.

maya: That priority map works. I’ll add a step in the runbook to switch to the first available fallback, and verify the KV cache TTLs so we don't hit cold-starts.

jordan: Also, long-term item: product needs a spec for acceptable fallback quality metrics. @ana can you capture the metric definitions so we can automate rollback thresholds?

ana: Will do. Starting a doc in docs/incidents/fallback-quality.md. Rough metrics: BLEU-ish for generation similarity, average latency delta, and error rate.

sam: One more ask: infra will need a short maintenance window to run the dry-run. Can ops coordinator (cc: @jordan) approve proposed windows?

jordan: Yes, send proposed windows and I’ll coordinate with SRE on comms.

ops-bot: Action update: "model-registry-token-rotation" moved to In Progress (liam).

liam: Quick note — running the synthetic 401 test locally now. Command I used: 
```
curl -X POST https://model-registry.internal/test-token -d '{"simulate": "expired_token"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer expired'
```
Got 401 as expected. Will wire this into CI.

ana: Thanks — add the CI job name to the tracker.

jordan: Great progress. I’ll compile these into the main incident action tracker and ping execs on status next week. If anything slips, escalate here with reason + new ETA.

maya: Adding a pre-mortem checklist item: run the failover dry-run quarterly.

sam: Adding dependency: notify partner-account team before dry-run so cloud account engineers are aware.

jordan: Closing note: everyone, please update your tracker rows by EOD Friday or I’ll assign a follow-up. :eyes: 

liam: Will do.

ana: On it.

maya: Done, tracker updated. :white_check_mark:
